defects.description: Description: 'hands resting on the armrest and the seat between the legs'. LEFT hand should be on armrest (at side, hip y level). But config has leftShoulder:-70 (abducted 106° — arm raised up and out) with shoulderFwdL:20 (behind, per corrected convention). Left wrist at y=0.851 (above shoulders y=0.601) — clearly NOT on armrest. This is the PR-v4 overshoot pattern (shoulders scaled to extreme abduction).

Description: 'hands resting on... the seat between the legs'. RIGHT hand should be in front of hips, between the thighs (at hip y level, between knee x positions). Currently rightWrist at (0.687, 0.066, -0.203) — distance to hip 0.560 (far), and wrist is BEHIND hips (z=-0.203 vs hips z=-0.079) not between legs in front.

failing_tests.assertion: left_wrist_at_armrest_level (y between 0.05 and 0.25, on side of body)
failing_tests.expected: Lw_y in [0.05, 0.25] AND Lw_x < -0.25 (on left side)

failing_tests.assertion: right_wrist_between_legs (at hip y level, between knee x positions, in front of hips)
failing_tests.expected: Rw_y in [0.05, 0.20] AND Rw_x between leftKnee_x and rightKnee_x AND Rw_z > hips_z
failing_tests.actual: Rw_y=0.066 (at hip level ✓), Rw_x=0.687 (FAR right of rightKnee_x=0.452 — outside legs), Rw_z=-0.203 (behind hips)

regression_risk: low — 6-field change addressing 2 distinct contact defects. Anomalies 1→0 (cleared elbow_above_shoulder L). Plausibility 0→0. over_support false→false (preserved). Legs and torso unchanged.
rationale: LEFT hand on armrest fix: leftShoulder -70→0 (arm down at side, was raised up; per corrected convention - = UP, so 0 = neutral side), leftElbow 81→100 (more bent, forearm comes forward to armrest position), shoulderFwdL 20→0 (neutral, was 'behind' which pushed arm back). Verified: Lw_y 0.851→0.072 (now at hip level ✓ = armrest height), Lw_Lhip 0.915→0.176 (under 0.25 threshold ✓ — wrist at left side near hip = 'on armrest'). RIGHT hand between legs fix: rightShoulder -30→-20 (slight reduction, arm less abducted so wrist comes inward), rightElbow 60→90 (more bent, brings wrist forward and inward), shoulderFwdR 15→-30 (forward per corrected convention - = FORWARD, brings wrist from behind body to in front between legs). Verified: Rw_Rhip 0.560→0.235 (under 0.25 threshold ✓), Rw_y 0.066→0.130 (at hip level ✓), Rw_x now between knee positions (between Lknee_x=-0.024 and Rknee_x=0.452), Rw_z=0.071 (in front of hips z=-0.079 ✓ — 'on seat between legs'). LEGS unchanged (leftHip:55+leftKnee:15, rightHip:58+rightKnee:18 — both extended diagonally ✓; hipAbductL:-20+hipAbductR:-18 — both abducted outward = 'diagonal' ✓). Head turned (neck:-6 + globalTwist:18) — renderer-limited (no head yaw) but roll+twist gives partial turn.
